title: Wild type, variant, polymorphism, rare variant and S N P

segs.text: Section thirty six. Wild type, variant, polymorphism, rare variant and S N P. These terms name versions of a gene by how common they are. Wild type is the version of a gene thought to be the most common. Sometimes the literature's wild type is only the version scientists understood first, but she accepts the most common as the definition. A variant is a version of the gene not thought to be common. Say variant, not mutant. She uses neutral words for genetic changes, and mutant is no longer commonly used.

Polymorphism and rare variant sort variants by frequency, with the cutoff at one percent. A genetic variant present in at least one percent of the population is a polymorphism. One present in less than one percent is a rare variant. She said, by definition, a polymorphism occurs at least one percent of the time in a population. A single nucleotide polymorphism, an S N P, pronounced snip, is one nucleotide that differs from the wild type sequence. It is the most common type of polymorphism. But S N P names a kind of change, not a frequency.

That is why a whole gene deletion can be a polymorphism. She said, polymorphism definition speaks to the frequency of that change happening. More than one nucleotide changed, an entire gene inserted or deleted, extra copies of a gene: any of these is a polymorphism if it occurs in at least one percent of the population, and a rare variant if less. So the statement that polymorphisms are only single nucleotide changes is false. And a variant that occurs very frequently describes a polymorphism, not a haplotype.

Why did the term rare variant appear? For a long time the work focused on polymorphisms, and known polymorphisms explained many differences in drug response. Then some patients reacted badly to a drug without carrying the known polymorphism. Their genotype showed an uncommon variation found in less than one percent of people. The variant is rare, but the bad reaction is just as real for that patient, so these variants now get attention.
